conviction_note: Revenue will very likely beat again, as it has beaten the top of the company's own guide for three quarters running. But the stock fell about 10% on two of the last three such beats when the next guide slowed. Q4 faces a 29%-growth base, a delayed iPhone 18 base model, China phone shipments down 10-15% and October telecom retail sales slowing from +31% to +6.5%, against a street full year that needs roughly +18-22% in Q4. So p_up is 45 on an absolute move of 9 points. The findings sum to -0.3 because the likely beat and the used-price tailwind offset most of the guide risk. The gap between the two numbers is the reaction function, not an inconsistency.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue consensus $944.0M (about RMB6.35-6.40bn, at the low end of the company guide of RMB6,340-6,440m, +23.1-25.1% y/y) and EPS $0.10. Source: Earnings Whispers preview of 2026-11-11, https://finviz.com/news/421323/atrenews-slower-guide-puts-margins-not-growth-at-center-of-third-quarter-test. The guide is from the Q2 release, https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/RERE/2608200299. The revenue bar is anchored to a company guide. The EPS bar is disputed: the preview says Q2 was $0.08, while the release gives adjusted diluted EPS of RMB0.97 (about $0.14 per ADS). Implied street Q4: the FY2026 revenue consensus of RMB26.8bn (4 analysts, low 26.2, high 27.0; https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/rere/forecast/, checked 2026-11-06) less Q1 6.16bn, Q2 6.61bn and a Q3 of 6.4-6.65bn leaves about RMB7.4-7.6bn for Q4, or +18-22% on Q4 2025's RMB6,254m.

The Earnings Whispers preview of 2026-11-11 says the market needs earnings growth despite sequentially lower revenue, retail mix near or above 50% of product revenue, margins at or above Q2, service revenue back to growth or a smaller decline, and an update on iPhone 18 trade-in timing (https://finviz.com/news/421323/atrenews-slower-guide-puts-margins-not-growth-at-center-of-third-quarter-test).

Q3 guide of +23-25% was called below expectations. Stock -4.8% premarket, -11.1% at the close (baseline; https://finviz.com/news/383970/atrenew-shares-fall-as-softer-q3-outlook-overshadows-second-quarter-earnings-beat). Earlier 2026 prints: 2026-03-11 -10.1% (beat the Q4 guide, Q1 guide +25.9-28.1%) and 2026-05-19 +11.6% (beat the Q1 guide, Q2 guide +25-27%).

expectations.real_bar: Beat Q3 revenue (base case) and guide Q4 revenue at or above about +20% y/y (RMB7.5bn or more) with the non-GAAP operating margin at or above Q2's 3.1%, despite the high Q4 2025 base and the delayed iPhone 18 base model.

next_guide.street_next_quarter: Implied about RMB7.4-7.6bn for Q4 2026 (+18-22% y/y): FY2026 consensus RMB26.8bn (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/rere/forecast/) less reported Q1 and Q2 and the Q3 consensus. No published quarterly Q4 consensus found.
next_guide.street_full_year: RMB26.8bn FY2026 revenue (range 26.2-27.0), non-GAAP EPS RMB2.82 (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/rere/forecast/). Zacks SCR RMB26.2bn (https://scr.zacks.com/news/news-details/2026/RERE-Demand-Remains-Strong-in-the-Secondary-Market-for-Smartphones-Despite-Market-Challenges--/default.aspx).
next_guide.company_current_guide: Q3 2026 revenue RMB6,340-6,440m (+23.1-25.1%). No Q4 or full-year numeric guide; management said it expects 'strong growth in both revenue and profit this year' (https://www.webull.com/news/15435307479507968).
next_guide.basis: The growth guide has stepped down from 25.9-28.1% to 25-27% to 23-25%. Q4 laps +29% growth with the iPhone 17 base launch and subsidies. The iPhone 18 base model is staggered (Zacks 2026-08-21), China Q3 shipments fell 10-15% with Counterpoint warning of Q4 pressure, and October telecom retail growth slowed to +6.5% from +31.1%. Against that, used-phone prices rose on memory costs and 1P retail grows about 90%. A guide near +15-22% is the likely range, at or slightly below the street's implied +18-22%.

findings.finding: ATRenew has beaten the top of its own revenue guide three quarters running: Q4 2025 RMB6,254m above the top; Q1 2026 RMB6,160m vs a 5,860-5,960m guide (+3.4% over the top); Q2 2026 RMB6,609m vs 6,240-6,340m (+4.2% over the top). The Q3 consensus of $944M sits at the LOW end of the RMB6,340-6,440m guide. Repeating the pattern gives about RMB6.6-6.7bn, roughly 4-6% above consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: All three beats above the top of the guide: -10.1% (2026-03-11), +11.6% (2026-05-19), -11.1% (2026-08-20). The beat did not decide the sign; the next guide did.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus at the low end of the guide means the street has not modelled the habitual over-delivery. If it had, the revenue estimate would sit at or above the top ($957M), not at $944M, down from about $969M earlier.
findings.independence: Q1 2026 guide and beat: https://aihuishou.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/atrenew-inc-reports-unaudited-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025 and https://www-web.itiger.com/news/2636383503. Q2 beat: https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/RERE/2608200299. Q3 demand corroborated by the NBS series in the next finding.

findings.finding: China's telecom-equipment retail sales (value) rose 20.4% y/y in July and 31.1% in September 2026 (Jan-Sep +18.1%), against total retail sales of +0.6% and +1.1%. Q3 phone spending in value terms was strong despite fewer units, consistent with the memory-driven price rise that also lifts used-phone ASPs.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No company-specific reaction on this line; it feeds the Q3 revenue beat in the previous finding.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a public macro series, mostly priced. It is filed as corroboration of the beat, sized small as a macro-to-company proxy.

findings.finding: October 2026 telecom-equipment retail sales slowed to +6.5% y/y from +31.1% in September, and total retail sales to +0.4% (expected +0.8%). This is the first month of ATRenew's Q4, the quarter the company will guide on 19 Nov, against a Q4 2025 base that grew 29%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A decelerating next-quarter guide was sold -10.1% (2026-03-11) and -11.1% (2026-08-20). A held guide was bought +11.6% (2026-05-19).
findings.why_not_priced: Published two sessions before the print and macro, so street Q4 models (FY 26.8bn, checked 2026-11-06, implying +18-22% in Q4) predate it. Had it been priced, the FY consensus would have come down toward Zacks' 26.2bn.
findings.independence: Proxy: the company has not confirmed October trends. Counterpoint's 2026-10-19 Q4 warning (next finding) points the same way from a different source.

findings.finding: China Q3 2026 smartphone shipments fell 10% y/y (Counterpoint, lowest Q3 since 2012) to 15.4% (IDC, 57.9M units) on memory-cost price rises. Counterpoint warns this 'could further weaken smartphone demand and put additional pressure on Q4 sales'. The iPhone 18 base model is staggered (Zacks SCR 2026-08-21), which removes part of the Q4 trade-in wave that the Q4 2025 base enjoyed. Partial offset in the same Counterpoint note: iPhone 18 Pro sales in the first three weeks were +23.5% vs the iPhone 17 Pro, and consumers are 'turning to the refurbished market'.
findings.link: Trade-in and new-phone launches drive ATRenew's recycling intake; iPhone recycling is its largest product line; Apple and JD trade-in partnerships.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The guide is the line that moved this stock on each 2026 print (-10.1%, +11.6%, -11.1%).
findings.why_not_priced: Public for a month, so partly priced. KWEB fell 10% over the same 20 days while RERE was flat, so the stock does not look discounted for a softer Q4.

findings.finding: Used-phone prices have surged on memory costs. Daily national used-phone processing went from about 200k to nearly 1.5M units in six months, iPhone 17 used-trade volume rose 280% m/m after the Apple launch, and some models' recycling prices exceed the new launch price (Tech星球 2026-10-10). On 2026-08-20 the CEO said 'prices for high-quality pre-owned products will have room for upside'. Q2 1P gross margin was 15.7% vs 13.2%, and 1P retail is 48.8% of product revenue. ATRenew earns about 90% of revenue from price spreads, so rising used ASPs lift revenue and support the margin bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin expansion accompanied the 2026-05-19 +11.6% print. On 2026-08-20 margin expansion (non-GAAP OPM 3.1%, +69bp) did not stop the -11.1% fall on the guide.
findings.why_not_priced: Chinese-language trade press that the US-listed holder base of a 4-analyst ADR rarely reads. If priced, revenue consensus would not have been cut from about $969M to $944M.
findings.independence: CEO remark: https://www.webull.com/news/15435307479507968 (2026-08-20 transcript). Counterpoint on the shift to refurbished: https://counterpointresearch.com/de/insights/china-smartphone-shipments-hit-14-year-low-in-q3-2026. Higher acquisition costs could squeeze the spread; the risk is reflected in the range.

findings.finding: Reaction function: on the three 2026 prints this stock moved about 10-12% either way, set by the next-quarter guide and not the beat. The two decelerating guides were sold (-10.1%, -11.1%) and the held guide was bought (+11.6%). The Q3 guide already stepped down to +23-25%, and Q4 laps the hardest base of the year.
findings.why_not_priced: Not a fact about the quarter. It is how the holder base reacts to deceleration, sized small and used mainly for p_up and abs_move.
findings.independence: Baseline price history, a different source from the article.

findings.finding: RERE was flat over 20 sessions into the print while KWEB fell 10.0%, and fell 3.9% vs KWEB's 7.4% over 5 sessions. The relative resilience means the stock is not discounted for a soft Q4 guide. Spot $4.01 is 40% below the mean target of $6.64 (4 analysts, all Strong Buy, no target change since July).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Before the 2026-08-20 print the stock was near $4.57 (MarketBeat 2026-08-17) and fell 11%.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the price itself, so it measures what is priced rather than adding information. The point is that the relative strength leaves no cushion for a disappointing guide.

findings.finding: JD.com, ATRenew's trade-in channel partner, reported Q3 2026 electronics and home-appliance revenue of RMB127.7bn, -0.7% y/y (vs -11.8% in Q2 2026), on 2026-11-17. The trade-in channel stabilised in Q3, and JD supported the iPhone 18 Pro launch and trade-in service via Joybuy/JD Logistics.
findings.link: JD trade-in programme: ATRenew runs JD's recycling and trade-in services (company site, https://www.atrenew.com/en-us/business/aihuishou). Revenue share via JD not sourced.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured reaction of RERE to JD prints found.
findings.why_not_priced: Released the session before ATRenew's print; RERE closed 4.08 then 4.015, with no visible read-through. Small: JD's electronics line is mostly new devices.
findings.independence: NBS Q3 telecom retail series (finding 2) points the same way for Q3.

findings.finding: Buyback: about 1M ADSs (US$4.2m) repurchased in Q2. Cumulative US$14.8m of a US$50m programme, extended 12 months from 2026-06-30. About US$35m remains, roughly 4% of a market cap of about US$870m.
findings.why_not_priced: Known since August, so priced. A dividend or upsized programme on the print would be new, but none is sourced.

findings.finding: The Q3 EPS consensus of $0.10 looks low against Q2 adjusted diluted EPS of RMB0.97 (about $0.14 per ADS), on only about 3% lower revenue at the guide midpoint. Q2 adjusted operating income rose 70% on 3.1% OPM. The bar is disputed: the preview states Q2 as $0.08.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 adjusted EPS beat RMB0.97 vs RMB0.89 and the stock fell 11.1%.
findings.why_not_priced: Capped small because the EPS bar cannot be sourced to two agreeing estimates (preview $0.10 with Q2 shown at $0.08 vs the release's RMB0.97).
findings.independence: Preview: https://finviz.com/news/421323/atrenews-slower-guide-puts-margins-not-growth-at-center-of-third-quarter-test (it disagrees on the Q2 base).

outside_window.finding: The fate of China's national trade-in subsidy into 2027 is unresolved: no 2027 smartphone-subsidy announcement found. Zacks calls it a source of uncertainty for H2 2026 and 2027 demand.

searched_and_found_nothing: mid-quarter statements: none found after 2026-08-20 (the date of the last call). No ATRenew press release, conference remark or reaffirmation dated September to November 2026 apart from the 2026-11-05 results-date notice.
No ATRenew-specific iPhone 18 launch trade-in figures.
No cause found for the Nov 12 -7.7% day; KWEB fell 3.2% the same day, so it is probably sector-driven.
No whisper number or published quarterly Q4 consensus.
No Zhuanzhuan/Xianyu financial print for Q3 2026; Zhuanzhuan discloses no financials.
ir.atrenew.com and aihuishou.gcs-web.com returned 403 to WebFetch (access, not budget); figures were taken from secondary copies of the releases.

baseline_tension: No skew to read. The baseline history is untrustworthy, but the confirmed 2026 prints moved about 10-12% each, so I raised the scale to 9. RERE outperformed KWEB by about 10 points into the print, which cuts against the stock being priced for a soft guide; that supports my lean slightly negative but keeps it small.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction): revenue-beat finding cut from +1.0 to +0.6, because this name sold two of its last three beats on the guide.
Lesson 5 (a narrow proxy loses to a broad series; macro-to-company is small): October telecom retail cut from -1.5 to -1.0, shipments from -0.8 to -0.6, Q3 telecom retail from +0.4 to +0.3.
Lesson 6 (verify the bar): EPS finding capped from +0.4 to +0.2 because the two sources disagree on the base.
Lessons 8 and 'history from the wrong events': abs_move rebuilt from confirmed results dates (2026 prints 10.1, 11.6, 11.1; six-print median 8.1) and raised from 8 to 9.
Lesson 7: short interest checked, about 0.9% of float, not crowded; no skew; negatives not shrunk for positioning.
The sum is unchanged at -0.3 because the cuts fell on both signs; the scaled move went from -0.8 to -0.9 on the larger abs_move.
